prompt.en: Can the third signer veto two colluding signers in ordinary 2-of-3 custody?
prompt.sw: Msaini wa tatu anaweza kuwazuia wawili wanaoshirikiana kuiba katika 2 kati ya 3 ya kawaida?

label.en: Yes, every signer has a veto
label.sw: Ndiyo, kila msaini ana kura ya kuzuia

label.en: No; two keys satisfy the spending threshold

explanation.en: A threshold does not enforce member consent or prevent threshold collusion.
explanation.sw: Kiwango hakitekelezi ridhaa ya wanachama wala kuzuia ushirikiano wa wasaini wanaotosha.

prompt.en: An official leaves. What does removing their name from minutes do to the old key?
prompt.sw: Kiongozi anaondoka. Kuondoa jina kwenye kumbukumbu kunafanya nini kwa ufunguo wa zamani?

label.sw: Huondoa nakala zote moja kwa moja

label.en: Does not revoke its technical spending ability
label.sw: Hakuondoi uwezo wake wa kiufundi wa kutumia

explanation.en: A new policy and verified transfer may be needed; old-wallet funds remain governed by old keys.
explanation.sw: Sera mpya na uhamisho uliohakikiwa vinaweza kuhitajika; pesa za zamani bado hutegemea funguo za zamani.

prompt.en: What should a chair avoid collecting?

label.en: Every signer's seed phrase in one place
label.sw: Maneno ya siri ya kila msaini mahali pamoja

explanation.en: Concentrating all secrets defeats independent custody and adds a common failure source.
explanation.sw: Kukusanya siri zote huondoa kujitegemea na kuongeza chanzo cha kushindwa pamoja.

prompt.en: One key is missing and a second signer is temporarily unreachable. What is true?
prompt.sw: Ufunguo mmoja haupo na msaini wa pili hapatikani kwa muda. Ukweli ni upi?

label.en: Access can be delayed even without permanent loss of two keys
label.sw: Upatikanaji unaweza kuchelewa bila funguo mbili kupotea milele

label.en: The remaining signer can sign twice

explanation.en: Technical loss tolerance still depends on timely access to enough independent keys and configuration.
explanation.sw: Uvumilivu wa kupotea bado unahitaji funguo huru za kutosha na mpangilio kwa wakati.
